text:
kira (sre): follow-up on recurring degradation during scale events. pattern: autoscaler backfills + cold KV = repeated p99 spikes and throughput drop. proposing a 'burst-protection' SLO that separates expected scale-window behavior from steady-state latency so we stop burning the latency budget for every ramp.

jin (infra): agree. infra will add tags for autoscaler_join and a startup_grace flag. i'll own rollout (ETA 36h).

omar (serving): serving items: KV pre-warm, soft batch caps during detected ramps, and fallback routing to smaller models. i'll take implementation + alerts (ETA 72h).

maya (product): product wants opt-in for enterprise customers first and comms + SLA wording. i'll draft customer note (ETA 24h).

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-078 logged: autoscaler backfill correlated with KV misses.

kira (sre): draft SLO (example):
```yaml
service: inference-api
slo:
  steady_latency:
    p99_ms: "500"
    window: "30d"
  burst_protection:
    type: "throughput_oriented"
    p95_rps: "140"
    burst_window: "10m"
error_budget_reallocation:
  enabled: "true"
  max_reallocation: "0.02"
  per_customer_limit: "0.01"
annotations:
  note: "burst_protection evaluated only when autoscaler_join>3 or region_failover_ratio>5%"
```

kira (sre): action checklist:
- jin (infra): tagging + startup_grace rollout (due 36h)
- omar (serving): KV pre-warm + batch cap + alerts (due 72h)
- maya (product): SLA review & comms draft (due 24h)
- kira (sre): PR to slo-config + dashboard panels (due 12h)

jin (infra): created PR https://git.redwood/slo-config/pulls/678 - adding tags and metric exports.

omar (serving): staging pre-warm looks stable; canary tomorrow. will post link.

maya (product): will loop in legal and prepare a short FAQ for customers.

kira (sre): scheduling decision meeting in 4 days to decide opt-in rollout vs global change. calendar: https://cal.link/4day-burst-decision. closing thread for now; please update this thread with PR links and canary results. :white_check_mark:
